verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, meaning no bulk export of events, issues, or project data in open formats and no documented exit path. The public API with an OpenAPI spec, the CLI log streaming, and the self-hosting option are building blocks or adjacent capabilities, not an export feature, so they earn no credit. Community notes about switching to GlitchTip by changing the DSN show SDK compatibility, not export of existing data.
